com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web
Web adapter of the authorization server: security filter chains, login page and OpenAPI description.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account
Self-service account REST API: registration, e-mail verification, password change and password reset.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.admin - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.admin
Administration of users and clients.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth
Client authentication at the token endpoints beyond a shared secret: private_key_jwt with replay protection (RFC 7523) and mutual TLS, tls_client_auth and self_signed_tls_client_auth (RFC 8705).
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients
Web adapter of registered client management: the administration endpoints, their DTOs, the startup seeding and the optional dynamic client registration.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.consent - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.consent
 
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.error - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.error
Error page of the server-rendered pages.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.exchange - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.exchange
OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693): the claims of the exchanged tokens.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit
OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) for input-constrained clients, such as a command line tool: the protocol customizer that wires the device authorization and verification endpoints, the guard that applies the multi-factor policy and the limit on the attempts to the verification endpoint, and the verification page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.keys - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.keys
Web adapter of the signing keys: the administration endpoints, the scheduled rotation job and the startup bootstrap.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.login - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.login
Login page, its controller and the extension points other authentication methods plug into.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.logout - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.logout
 
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa
Multi-factor authentication orchestration.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott
One-time token authentication: e-mail and SMS codes and magic links as a primary sign-in method and as a second factor, the per-channel factors, the rate limits, the providers and filters, and the phone management API and account page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.pages - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.pages
Rendering of the server-rendered HTML pages.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.pages.v1.generated.api - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.pages.v1.generated.api
 
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.par - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.par
Pushed authorization requests (RFC 9126), opt-in with authserver.par.enabled: the protocol chain customizer that enables the framework's pushed authorization request endpoint.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.passkeys - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.passkeys
Passkeys (WebAuthn): the factor, the chain wiring, the login and second-factor fragments, the account API and the account page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.password - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.password
Web adapter of the password-based sign-in: the Spring Security user details service over the use case, the password encoder and the authentication provider, which checks the account status only after the password.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ratelimit - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ratelimit
Rate-limiting building blocks shared by the features that limit their endpoints.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social
Social login (identity brokering) through external identity providers: Google, Microsoft Entra ID, Apple and GitHub.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.tokens - package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.tokens
Token customization (claims, formats, lifetimes): the claims extension point, the access-token customizer, the UserInfo mapper and the expired authorization cleanup job.

Time-based one-time password (TOTP) second factor.

ReplayRejectingJwtValidator - Class in com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth
Validates what the framework's default assertion validators leave out: the assertion must carry a jti, an iat no later than now (within the same clock skew the framework's timestamp validator allows) and an exp no more than the configured maximum lifetime after it, so a future iat cannot stretch the window, and its jti must not have been used before by the same client (RFC 7523, section 3).
